items.question: How often should my dog be professionally groomed?
items.answer: The ideal schedule depends on your dog’s breed, coat, lifestyle and the style you would like to maintain. Many coated breeds benefit from appointments every six to eight weeks, while others may need more or less frequent care. We will recommend a realistic schedule for your individual dog.

items.question: What is included in a full groom?
items.answer: A full groom is tailored to the dog but will usually include bathing, drying, brushing, coat preparation, clipping or scissoring, nail care and finishing. We will discuss your preferences and your dog’s coat condition before starting.

items.question: Can you groom nervous dogs?
items.answer: Yes. We regularly work with nervous, anxious and previously challenging dogs. We adapt our handling, allow appropriate time and prioritise your dog’s emotional and physical welfare throughout the appointment.

items.question: When should my puppy first visit the salon?
items.answer: We recommend introducing your puppy from around four months old, once their vaccinations are complete. Early visits are focused on confidence, familiarisation and creating a positive association with grooming.

items.question: Do you groom all breeds and sizes?
items.answer: Yes. Our experienced team works with a wide range of breeds, coat types and sizes. When you enquire, we may ask a few questions about your dog so we can allocate the most suitable appointment and groomer.

items.question: How do I book an appointment?
items.answer: Use the Book Now button on the website or contact the salon directly. Please tell us your dog’s breed, age, coat condition and any behavioural or medical information that could help us prepare for the appointment.
